sections.title: Security and data
points: We declare which data the agent reads, where it is stored and for how long.
Nothing is sent to a third party without appearing in the proposal.
Customer data is not used to train models.

sections.title: Access and controls
points: External integrations require authorisation and certification before they are connected.
Permissions are limited to the agreed scope, not to the whole system.
Any access can be revoked without dismantling the work.

Decisions that affect a person always have human review.

No. Published prices are references and contracting is subject to an approved quote, taxes and terms.

comparisons.title: Accompanied service or platform
comparisons.fitFor: There is no single answer: it depends on who will build, maintain and answer for the flow.
differences: Here someone answers for the outcome, not just for the tool.
The scope is written before work starts and can be rejected.
Integrations are certified before they are connected.
switching: We review what you already have working.
We keep what works and replace only the part that fails.
Nothing is turned off before the replacement is tested.

faq.q: Is a platform or a service better?
faq.a: It depends on whether you have a team to build and maintain. If you do, a platform usually pays off more. If you do not, a service avoids work nobody will do.

faq.q: Can I migrate what I already have?
faq.a: It is reviewed case by case. We do not promise a migration without seeing it first.

faq.q: Do you only work with sales?
faq.a: No. There are agents for customer service, marketing, finance, logistics and registrations.

faq.q: Do you work with non-technical teams?
faq.a: Yes. The requirement is an internal owner, not a programmer.

tasks.name: Sales Agent
tasks.promise: Every opportunity with its next step, without depending on someone remembering.

howItWorks.trigger: A query, a form or a new contact comes in.
howItWorks.decision: It separates the buyer from the browser.
howItWorks.action: It prepares the follow-up and leaves it ready for a person to review and send.

tasks.qualityBar: No follow-up leaves without an owner and a date, on every run.
tasks.shapedBy: The stages and rules are those of your process, not a closed template.

risk.security: We declare which data is read and where it is stored.
risk.access: Only authorised people can edit rules and lists.
risk.oversight: Every send is logged and can be stopped.

tasks.sharedStack: All agents share the same database, permissions and log, so adding another does not mean starting over.

cta.label: Put the sales agent to work

tasks.name: Customer Service Agent
tasks.promise: Every request reaches someone who can resolve it, on the first assignment.

howItWorks.trigger: A request comes in through any enabled channel.
howItWorks.decision: It identifies the subject and the real urgency, not the declared one.
howItWorks.action: It answers the repeatable and escalates what needs a person.

tasks.qualityBar: Misclassified requests are returned and feed the rule, on every run.
tasks.shapedBy: The categories are those of your operation, not a generic tree.

risk.security: Requester data does not leave the agreed environment.
risk.access: Each queue has a defined owner.

tasks.sharedStack: All agents share the same database, permissions and log, so adding another does not mean starting over.

cta.label: Put the customer service agent to work

tasks.name: Marketing Agent
tasks.promise: Material that comes from the offer and the context, not from a blank draft.

howItWorks.trigger: A piece is needed for a specific audience.
howItWorks.decision: It picks the argument that fits that audience and drops the one that does not.
howItWorks.action: It produces the draft and leaves it in review before delivery.

tasks.qualityBar: No piece is delivered without human review, on every run.
tasks.shapedBy: Tone and limits are set by your team.

risk.security: Customer data is not used in the material without authorisation.
risk.oversight: Every version is logged and can be reverted.

tasks.sharedStack: All agents share the same database, permissions and log, so adding another does not mean starting over.

cta.label: Put the marketing agent to work

tasks.name: Finance Agent
tasks.promise: Numbers arrive ordered and with their source, not on a loose sheet.

howItWorks.trigger: An invoice, a movement or a period close comes in.
howItWorks.decision: It checks that the record matches its source document.
howItWorks.action: It flags the difference and leaves it for review before posting.

tasks.qualityBar: No record is posted without its source document, on every run.
tasks.shapedBy: Accounting criteria are set by your team, not by the agent.

risk.security: Financial data does not leave the agreed environment.
risk.access: Only the authorised area accesses the records.
risk.oversight: Every flagged difference is logged with its reason.

tasks.sharedStack: All agents share the same database, permissions and log, so adding another does not mean starting over.

cta.label: Put the finance agent to work

tasks.name: Logistics Agent
tasks.promise: The state of a shipment is known before the customer asks.

howItWorks.trigger: A shipment is created or its state changes.
howItWorks.decision: It detects the deviation from the committed date.
howItWorks.action: It notifies the right person and proposes the next action.

tasks.qualityBar: No alert is sent without the source that supports it, on every run.
tasks.shapedBy: Committed times are set by your operation.

risk.security: Recipient data is handled under the declared legal basis.
risk.access: Each carrier sees only its shipments.
risk.oversight: Every alert is logged and can be audited.

tasks.sharedStack: All agents share the same database, permissions and log, so adding another does not mean starting over.

cta.label: Put the logistics agent to work

tasks.name: Chemistry, Pharmacy and Registrations Agent
tasks.promise: Files are checked against the applicable rule, not against someone's memory.

howItWorks.trigger: A file comes in, or a registration requirement falls due.
howItWorks.decision: It compares what was submitted against the current requirement list.
howItWorks.action: It flags what is missing and leaves it for review before submission.

tasks.qualityBar: No file is declared complete without the requirement list verified, on every run.
tasks.shapedBy: The rule and the requirement list are supplied by your team.

risk.security: Files are treated as regulated data and do not leave the agreed environment.
risk.access: Only authorised staff access each file.
risk.oversight: The final decision on a file is always human.

tasks.sharedStack: All agents share the same database, permissions and log, so adding another does not mean starting over.
